svg.aria-label: The weekly SEO audit loop. The /seo-analysis Claude Code skill pulls a snapshot from Google Search Console, Plausible, Ahrefs, GA4, HubSpot and PageSpeed. Then: diagnose which failure mode each page is in, pick the highest-ROI fixes (low-CTR pages, redirects and 404s, orphan pages, cannibalization, content gaps), ship them as a PR tagged SEO, content, docs, performance or fix, and 2-4 weeks later measure what each PR did to its URLs. Then it starts again the next week. That measurement is how I know one title and meta batch got +397 clicks.
svg.text: How I know one title + meta
